title: Lab test #1: news-shock short (USDC collateral ready)
journal: Hypothesis under test: when bearish news (exchange trouble, hacks, forced selling) is confirmed by price, a small SOL short opened within minutes and closed within hours earns more than it costs. Trigger today: X alleged abnormal Binance outflows and a 'hack' (unconfirmed, Binance denies it) while SOL slid under $100. The lab swaps part of its SOL into USDC to use as perps collateral; the news radar (fomo-radar) opens and manages the short automatically: 2x, stop if SOL rises 3.5%, take profit at -7%, 12h max. Each short is logged with its result; the idea is adopted into the book only if, after 20+ shocks, it beats random timing after costs.

orders.thesis: USDC collateral for the news-shock short test (perps need USDC).
